name: Quad Strider
description: Mech-style quadruped. Trot gait (diagonal pairs) for speed; relies on the mod holding the hull kinematically because two feet down is never statically stable.

proposal.summary: Fast travel walker. Trades static stability for ~3 b/s.
decisions: Hull is held kinematically by the walker controller (Sable body does not tip).
Front knees bend back, hind knees bend forward, for a readable silhouette.
openQuestions: Is kinematic support acceptable, or must every walker be statically stable?
Do we want automatic foothold search on by default?
